1 Launching Plezy on This PC

Desktop Application Menu:

2 Why Plezy vs. Web Player

Browsers (Chrome/Firefox) cannot play HEVC 10-bit, AV1, or TrueHD/DTS-HD audio without forcing your server CPU to transcode. Plezy uses libmpv directly on your client machine:

⚡ 100% DirectPlay

Plays 4K HDR, H.265/HEVC, and AV1 video directly without transcoding load or thermal throttling on the server.

🎨 Anime ASS/SSA Subtitles

Renders complex styling, typography, karaoke, and typesetting natively via libass without burning in.

⏩ Smart Skip Intro / Credits

Integrates with Jellyfin intro markers to skip openings and end credits seamlessly with one click.

🎧 Bitstream Audio Passthrough

Passes FLAC, Dolby Atmos, and DTS-HD Master Audio bitstreams directly to external DACs and soundbars.

3 Recommended Plezy Client Configurations

Fine-tune Plezy for maximum fidelity and buttery smooth playback:

A
Hardware Acceleration:

In Plezy ➔ Settings ➔ Player ➔ set Hardware Decoding to auto-safe or vaapi (Intel/AMD) / nvdec (NVIDIA).

B
Subtitles Tuning:

Set Subtitle Engine to libass. Under Subtitle Styling, configure your preferred fallback font (e.g. Noto Sans) for non-embedded subtitles.

C
HDR Tone-Mapping:

If watching HDR content on an SDR display, set Tone-Mapping Algorithm to spline or mobius for vibrant, non-washed-out colors.

4 Plezy on Mobile, Tablets & Smart TVs

Access your Jellyfin library with the same unified Plezy interface on all your screens:

📱 Android Phone & Tablet

Download the official APK directly from GitHub Releases (plezy-android-arm64-v8a.tar.gz).

📺 Android TV & Fire OS

Install via ADB or sideload on Chromecast, Sony TV, Nvidia Shield, or Fire TV Stick.

🍎 iOS & Apple TV

Install via the Apple App Store or TestFlight beta releases.

💻 Windows & macOS

Portable 7z packages and macOS DMG installers available for instant deployment.
